ERC20 private nested mapping of allowances
ERC20 private total token supply
ERC20 private token name string
ERC20 private token symbol string
GeneratorCopyright private version string
Internal view function returning msg.sender as the trusted sender identity
Public transfer(recipient, amount) delegating to _transfer with _msgSender()
Public transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) with allowance check and reduction
Public approve(spender, amount) delegating to _approve

Public decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue) with balance check
Internal _transfer moves balances, enforces zero-address and balance requirements

Internal _burn destroys tokens reducing balance and _totalSupply
Internal _approve writes _allowances and emits Approval
Internal virtual hook invoked before any token transfer, mint or burn
Payable constructor requiring initialBalance_ > 0 and minting to _msgSender()
Payable constructor forwarding msg.value to a receiver via IPayable.pay
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) to an arbitrary caller-supplied address
State write to _balances mapping inside _transfer/_mint/_burn
State write to _allowances mapping inside _approve
Arithmetic update of _totalSupply inside _mint/_burn
Caller-controlled address consumed by Context._msgSender and used as mint recipient
Constructor parameter for token name
Constructor parameter for token symbol

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender, making the caller identity flow into all authorization decisions
_msgSender() result is used as the mint recipient in the SimpleERC20 constructor
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_)
initialBalance_ is validated (> 0) and minted, directly determining total supply
name_ is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor and stored in _name
symbol_ is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor and stored in _symbol
feeReceiver_ becomes the payment receiver address used by ServicePayer
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer base constructor
ServicePayer constructor performs an external payable call to the receiver before contract state is fully initialized
_mint increments _balances[account] by amount
_mint increments _totalSupply by amount
_transfer decrements _balances[sender] and increments _balances[recipient]
transfer delegates all value movement to _transfer
transferFrom delegates all value movement to _transfer
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()]
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spent allowance
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the summed allowance
increaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced allowance
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances
currentAllowance local is assigned from _allowances[_msgSender()][spender]
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_burn decrements _balances[account] by amount
_burn decrements _totalSupply by amount
_approve writes the computed amount into _allowances[owner][spender]
_approve modifies the _allowances mapping state
transfer derives the from-address from _msgSender, tying authorization to the caller
approve derives the owner-address from _msgSender
transferFrom uses _msgSender as the spender for allowance checks
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner
SimpleERC20 constructor mints to _msgSender, giving the deployer the whole initial supply
amount parameter drives the balance arithmetic performed by transfer
recipient parameter receives tokens in transfer
spender parameter becomes the allowance beneficiary in approve
sender parameter is the debited account in transferFrom
addedValue parameter is summed into the existing allowance
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted with an underflow guard
account parameter is credited with minted amount
account parameter is debited by burn amount
owner parameter of _approve flows from the approve call path
owner parameter keys the _allowances mapping write inside _approve
amount parameter drives balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom
recipient parameter receives tokens in transferFrom
currentAllowance local is derived from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] inside transferFrom
senderBalance local caches _balances[sender] before the subtraction in _transfer
senderBalance is written back to _balances[sender] after the checked subtraction
accountBalance local caches _balances[account] before the burn subtraction
accountBalance is written back to _balances[account] after the checked subtraction

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor-only parameter; fold it into the SimpleERC20 constructor node
symbol_ is a constructor-only parameter; fold it into the SimpleERC20 constructor node
initialBalance_ is consumed only by the constructor validation and mint call
feeReceiver_ is consumed only by the ServicePayer constructor external payment
amount is consumed by the balance arithmetic inside _transfer
recipient is consumed by the balance credit inside _transfer
spender is consumed by the allowance write inside _approve
sender is the debited account consumed by _transfer
addedValue is consumed by the allowance arithmetic leading into _approve
subtractedValue is consumed by the allowance arithmetic leading into _approve
account is the credited account consumed by _mint
owner keys the allowance mapping written by _approve
senderBalance is a temporary cache of _balances used only inside _transfer
accountBalance is a temporary cache of _balances used only inside _burn
currentAllowance is a temporary cache of _allowances used only inside transferFrom/decreaseAllowance
